tests.name: all composite parent targets immediately unique and non-partial
receipt assignment equality unrelated updates and exact rejections

evidence.message: Student subscription receipt snapshots are immutable
Student subscription receipt snapshots are immutable

tests.name: allocation insert and immutability exact SQLSTATE

direct reconciliation rerun no catalog or data drift
historical forward reconciliation through real Drizzle dialect twice

constraints.name: student_subscription_allocations_amount_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((amount_minor > 0) AND (currency = 'NGN'::text) AND (((entry_type = 'CREDIT'::text) AND (recipient_type = ANY (ARRAY['SCHOOL'::text, 'PLATFORM'::text, 'PARTNER'::text]))) OR ((entry_type = 'REVERSAL'::text) AND (recipient_type = ANY (ARRAY['SCHOOL'::text, 'PLATFORM'::text, 'PARTNER'::text]))) OR ((entry_type = 'EXPENSE'::text) AND (recipient_type = 'PLATFORM_PROVIDER_FEE'::text)))))

constraints.name: student_subscription_allocations_attribution_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (attribution_id) REFERENCES school_partner_attributions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.definition: UNIQUE (id, payment_id, entry_type, recipient_type)

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((recipient_type = 'PARTNER'::text) AND (recipient_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attribution_id IS NOT NULL) AND (commission_rule_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((recipient_type <> 'PARTNER'::text) AND (recipient_id IS NULL))))

functions.name: protect_student_subscription_allocations
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_student_subscription_allocations()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student subscription allocations are immutable';
END;
$function$

functions.name: protect_student_subscription_allocations
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_student_subscription_allocations()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student subscription allocations are immutable';
END;
$function$
